summary: Implemented the PatchIter / GridPatchDataset feature. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coords) pairs with coords computed as start/stop per dimension in the original frame, including the channel row; set_rnd skips keys starting with "__"); monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter class; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates, with worker partitioning via numpy ceil and NotImplementedError("image dataset must implement len().") when len is unavailable; PatchDataset docstring uses dtype=float; math import removed); monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter; docs/source/data.rst adds a PatchIter autodoc entry after GridPatchDataset; tests/test_grid_dataset.py added with test_shape, test_loading_array, and an extra test_missing_length. Nothing was run and nothing was committed: tests were not executed, and the pinned patch values in test_loading_array are unverified against a real run. The GridPatchDataset docstring example output was derived by reasoning, not by execution. Line-length check found no new lines over 120 columns in the edited code; two pre-existing long docstring lines in utils.py (get_valid_patch_size) were left untouched.
